patch_description:
This program “crosses over” by replacing the current, heavier block (with extra RX + global_z) with the best-performing parameter-efficient ansatz structure from the other implementation. The new EVOLVE-BLOCK uses:
- Coarse-grained shared single-qubit rotations (RY and RZ split into two 4-qubit banks).
- A proven CZ entangling backbone and two shared-parameter CRZ layers (ring + chord), giving strong nonlinearity while keeping parameter count low.
This reduces parameters (targeting ~50 total) and improves generalization/validation accuracy while maintaining the exact same fixed training/feature-map/re-uploading/measurement pipeline.
